package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/practiceroute"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

const maximumPracticeLearningRequestBytes int64 = 512 << 10

type PracticeLearningHandler struct {
	Routes    practiceroute.Resolver
	Materials practiceroute.Materializer
}

func (handler PracticeLearningHandler) ResolveRoute(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	var payload domain.PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1
	if err := decodePracticeLearning(writer, request, &payload); err != nil {
		writePracticeLearningError(writer, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	route, created, err := handler.Routes.Resolve(request.Context(), request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), payload)
	if err != nil {
		writePracticeLearningError(writer, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusOK
	if created {
		status = http.StatusCreated
	}
	writePracticeLearningJSON(writer, status, route)
}

func (handler PracticeLearningHandler) ReconcileReadiness(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	var payload domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1
	if err := decodePracticeLearning(writer, request, &payload); err != nil {
		writePracticeLearningError(writer, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	if payload.RouteID != chi.URLParam(request, "routeID") || payload.StepID != chi.URLParam(request, "stepID") {
		writePracticeLearningError(writer, domain.ErrConflict)
		return
	}
	receipt, created, err := handler.Routes.ReconcileReadiness(request.Context(), request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), payload)
	if err != nil {
		writePracticeLearningError(writer, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusOK
	if created {
		status = http.StatusCreated
	}
	writePracticeLearningJSON(writer, status, receipt)
}

func (handler PracticeLearningHandler) EnsureMaterial(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	var payload domain.PracticeMaterialEnsureRequestV1
	if err := decodePracticeLearning(writer, request, &payload); err != nil {
		writePracticeLearningError(writer, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Materials.Ensure(
		request.Context(), request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), chi.URLParam(request, "materialKey"), payload,
	)
	if err != nil {
		writePracticeLearningError(writer, err)
		return
	}
	writePracticeLearningJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func decodePracticeLearning(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request, result any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(writer, request.Body, maximumPracticeLearningRequestBytes))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(result); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func writePracticeLearningError(writer http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	status, code := http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error"
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		status, code = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		status, code = http.StatusNotFound, "not_found"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		status, code = http.StatusConflict, "idempotency_conflict"
	}
	writePracticeLearningJSON(writer, status, map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}

func writePracticeLearningJSON(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	writer.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(payload)
}
